title: Writing assistant
summary: An assistant in the app that helps the author write the book.
description: The assistant supports the author's own work on the book. It challenges and informs the writing; the writing stays the author's.

requirements.text: The app has an assistant that helps the author write the book.
The assistant never adds or changes text in the book.
The assistant helps only in the ways listed in `assistant.actions`.

values.description: The ways the assistant may help the author.
